name: Go, Diego, Go!
description: Go, Diego, Go! is a children's television series created by Chris Gifferd and Valerie Walsh, and is a spin-off of Dora the Explorer. The show premiered on September 6, 2005 and ended on September 16, 2011 on Nickelodeon. It also aired as part of the Nick Jr. on CBS block from September 17, 2005 to September 9, 2006. On December 20, 2006, Nick Jr. announced that it had ordered twenty new episodes that were in production. Since April 2008, the show has been dubbed into Spanish and airs in the United States on Univision as part of their Planeta U block.

videos.title: Rescue the Red-Eyed Tree Frogs!
videos.overview: Diego and Alicia find out about tree frogs once Diego learns that there are tree frogs in trouble.  Alicia figures out that they are Red-Eyed Tree Frog's, and Diego figures out that the wind blew the tree frogs off of their tree and they are going down the river.  Alicia tries to find the tree fogs a new home while Diego and Baby Jaguar try to save them.  Along their way, they face several new challenges, such as finding a way to get across a muddy pit, jumping over rolling coconuts, finding their way into a pyramid that the tree frogs went into, and finding their way through the pyramid to get to the tree frogs.

videos.title: Diego Saves the Mommy and Baby Sloth
videos.overview: Diego and a sloth, Sammy, try to save a mother sloth and her baby before a mudslide hits their tree.  On the way they face several challenges.  They must row across a rocky lake, tiptoe quietly around birds, and find the right path to go down.  They also have to find an animal that can help them climb a rocky mountain.

videos.title: Chinta the Baby Chinchilla
videos.overview: When Diego learns of a little chinchilla who got lost from her family, he helps the chinchilla to find her way home to Chinchilla Mountain to be reunited with her family.  Along their way, they face new challenges!  Some of those include choosing the right path with the wrong path being filled with snakes, and finding a way up Chinchilla Mountain to get the little chinchilla back with her family.

videos.title: Diego Saves Baby Humpback Whale
videos.overview: When Diego learns that a baby humpback whale is in trouble, he takes off right away to save it.  Along his way, he faces exciting new challenges.  Some of those challenges include finding the right path to get to the whale, finding an animal to help him get around some jellyfish, and having to out swim sharks!  The trouble doesn't stop there though, as Diego has to also figure out a way to get the baby humpback whale off of the beach and back into the ocean.

videos.title: Journey to Jaguar Mountain
videos.overview: Baby Jaguar is full of pride when he thinks that he is big enough to get to the top of Jaguar Mountain.  Diego and Baby Jaguar's mother agree to meet him at the top of Jaguar Mountain.  Does Baby Jaguar have the skills to make it up to the top, or will the obstacles prove to be too much trouble for him to handle?

videos.title: Three Little Condors
videos.overview: Diego and Alicia have been nursing three baby condors, but now it is time for them to get their own home! The condors are thrilled that they are being adopted, and they get a new mommy and daddy. But there is a problem, condors cannot fly at night. So the condors and Diego must hurry and get them home before nightfall.

videos.title: Pepito's Penguin School
videos.overview: Diego and Alicia are far away from home! They are on a trip doing some research and animal help in Antarctica, and this trip proves to be a busy one! A little penguin, Pepito, is lost and cannot find his way to his new school. Diego must help him find where his new school is, and how to get there.

videos.title: Armadillo's Rainforest Race
videos.overview: An Armadillo wants to compete in the big Rainforest Race, but sadly, she cannot find a team to join.  Diego decides that he will join her team, and together they participate in the games.

videos.title: The Mommy Macaw
videos.overview: A young Macaw and his baby egg brother or sister are in trouble!  Their tucked safely into their nest, but their mommy is nowhere to be found.  Diego goes on a search to find their mommy, and finds her stuck and unable to get out on her own.  After he rescues her, he has to find a way to treat her so they can make their trip back to the nest before her little egg hatches.

videos.title: Linda the Llama Saves Carnival
videos.overview: Diego and a Llama named Linda try to get to the Carnival in time so Linda can pull the float.  But with all of the obstacles in their way, will they be able to get there before the Carnival is over?

videos.title: A Booboo on the Pygmy Marmoset
videos.overview: Diego and Alicia must rescue a father and little pygmy marmoset from the prickly thorns. They need to cure the pygmy marmosets' booboos to make them feel better.

videos.title: A Blue Morpho Butterfly is Born
videos.overview: Baby Jaquar roars too loud and accidentally frightens a new baby blue moorpho butterfly away. Diego sets out to rescue him and bring him back home safely.

videos.title: Cool Water for Ana the Anaconda
videos.overview: Diego rescues Ana the Anaconda who got separated from her friends when the river has been dried out. Diego needs to bring Ana the Anaconda to the water where all of her friends are.

videos.title: Linda the Librarian
videos.overview: Linda the Llama is delivering all of the library books to a new library on top of the mountain.

videos.title: Chito and Rita the Spectacled Bears
videos.overview: Diego and Dora team up to help Chito and Rita the Spectacled Bears by making a new home in the tallest trees in the cloud forest.

videos.title: The Great Dinosaur Adventure (1)
videos.overview: In this special two part episode, a Maiasaura duck-billed dinosaur has lost his way and it's up to Dora, Diego, Alicia and Baby Jaquar to travel to the Cretaceous period back in time to rescue him.

videos.title: The Great Dinosaur Adventure (2)
videos.overview: In the conclusion of this special two-part episode, a Maiasaura duck-billed dinosaur has lost his way and it's up to Dora, Diego, Alicia and Baby Jaquar to travel to the Cretaceous period back in time to rescue him.

videos.title: Diego's Wolf Pup Rescue
videos.overview: Mommy Maned Wolf has lost her little wolf pup in the tall grass. She sets out in search of him with the help of Diego.

videos.title: Baby Jaguar to the Rescue
videos.overview: Baby Jaguar is trying to get his animal-rescue patch, but first he has to rescue three more animals in trouble.

videos.title: Rescue the Sea Turtles
videos.overview: The sea turtles need to lay their eggs but the beach is too dirty. Diego and Alicia need to clean it up before it's time to lay the eggs.

videos.title: Diego Saves Baby River Dolphin
videos.overview: Baby River Dolphin got stuck in a puddle after a rainstorm! But he must get back home because today is the day he'll turn pink like a BIG River Dolphin

videos.title: Diego and Baby Humpback to the Rescue
videos.overview: A sunken ship traps King Humpback Whale's tail at the bottom of the ocean.

videos.title: Little Kinkajou is in Beehive Trouble
videos.overview: Little Kinkajou got his head stuck in a beehive. Papa Kinkajou joins Diego in a mission to rescue Little Kinkajou before the bees return.

videos.title: Macky the Macaroni Penguin
videos.overview: Using Click, Diego finds a lost newborn penguin, Macky the Macaroni Penguin. Diego must take her back home and meet Alicia there to see all the other baby penguins being born.

videos.title: Diego Saves Christmas!
videos.overview: Linda the Llama and Diego set out to rescue Santa and his reindeer when his sleigh stacked high with toys gets stuck in the deep snow.

videos.title: The Great Jaguar Rescue!
videos.overview: The Bobo brothers are up to no good again when they capture baby jaguar's growl and seal it in a magical bottle. It's up to Diego to get his growl back for him.

videos.title: Diego the Hero
videos.overview: Diego, along with the aid of Baby Jaguar, Mommy Maned Wolf, Sammy the Sloth, Baby Humpback Whale, and Linda the Llama, help rescue Alicia and some injured penguins, who are stuck in the ice on a boat and need to be taken to the Snowy Rescue Center.

videos.title: Sammy's Valentine
videos.overview: Sammy the Sloth has a Valentine's Day gift for Lulu, but he needs Diego's help to deliver it to her.

videos.title: The Great Roadrunner Race
videos.overview: Roady the roadrunner is getting ready for his big race, but first he and Diego need to face many obstacles in the desert in order to make it to the race in time.

videos.title: The Tapir's Trip Home
videos.overview: Diego and the Tapir travel by Chucho the Train to find the perfect environment for the Tapir to call home.

videos.title: Jorge the Little Hawk Learns to Migrate
videos.overview: Diego must build a bird plane so he can follow Jorge the Little Hawk as they set out in search of a warmer climate for him to live in.

videos.title: Giant Octopus to the Rescue
videos.overview: Before the volcanoes erupt, Diego and the Giant Octopus must come to the rescue of animals that have become trapped in coral caves.

videos.title: An Underwater Mystery
videos.overview: Lucy the Fish has no idea what kind of fish she is, so it's up to Diego and Alicia to figure it out from certain clues and then help her find her way back to the proper home.

videos.title: Diego's Safari Rescue
videos.overview: Where are all the African elephants? A mean magician turned them into rocks, so Diego, Alicia, and a Baby Jaguar join Animal Rescuer Juma to find Erin the Elephant and a hidden magic drum that can break the spell and help all the animals in Africa. They'll need your help on this big Safari Rescue!

videos.title: Diego and Alicia Save the Otters!
videos.overview: Diego and Alicia must save two baby otters that became separated when the Bobo brothers were messing around in the water and create a huge wave.

videos.title: The Iguana Sing Along
videos.overview: Diego helps Iggy the Iguana find his way out of a cold and dark cave and back to his Iguana friends in time for the big Iguana sing along.

videos.title: Panchita the Prairie Dog Finds a New Prairie
videos.overview: Diego and Alicia set out in search of a new home for Panchita the prairie dog in this Old West-themed adventure.

videos.title: Alicia Saves the Crocodile
videos.overview: Kyra the Crocodile is lost and Alicia must travel to the dirty city pond to help her find her way back home.

videos.title: Green Iguana Helps Abuelito Plant a New Strawberry Farm!
videos.overview: It's the growing season and time for Abuelito's Strawberry Festival! But when a strong Windy Wind blows all the strawberries away, Alicia must ask Diego for help.

videos.title: Kicho's Magic Flute!
videos.overview: Diego is visiting his good friend Kicho in the mountains. Kicho is an indigenous boy from the Andes who is an expert in music and instruments. His favorite instrument - a magic flute!

videos.title: Rainforest Rhapsody
videos.overview: Puma wants to sing in Alicia's rainforest concert, but when he scares off the other animal singers, Diego and the Red-Eyed Tree Frogs need your help to find them all again!

videos.title: Gorilla Fun
videos.overview: Diego joins his friend Juma back in Africa to search for two missing baby Mountain Gorillas who are going to be crowned king! Will you help find the future Gorilla Kings?

videos.title: Rhea is an Animal Rescuer
videos.overview: Diego helps a Rhea - he can't fly, but that's okay because there's other things he can do - like running super fast. Diego invites him to be an animal rescuer!

videos.title: Whistling Willie Finds a Buddy
videos.overview: "A duck and a jaguar make really silly friends!" sing Willie the Whistling Duck and Baby Jaguar. Willie's never seen a jaguar before, and the two quickly become buddies.

videos.title: Super Flying Squirrel to the Rescue!
videos.overview: When a nest of baby birds falls into a river, Diego gets some help from a super Flying Squirrel to rescue them! Will you help too on this high-flying rescue?.

videos.title: Diego and Porcupine Save the Pinata!
videos.overview: Diego and Alicia are having a party for Porcupine's birthday. Porcupine loves parties, especially the pinata! But the Bobos accidentally tie balloons on the pinata and send it floating in the air!

videos.title: The Bobo's Mother's Day!
videos.overview: Diego needs you on a mountain rescue to help Miami Flamingo make it back to Flamingo Lake in time to see her baby hatch... and to save the rising lake water too!

videos.title: It's a Bug's World!
videos.overview: Diego, who has shrunken to bug size, helps a special bug make her way through the raindrop and spider webs in time for her to make it back to the beetle dance.

videos.title: Save The Giant Tortoises
videos.overview: Lonely Louie is a rare Giant Tortoise from the Galapagos Islands who wants to find a friend. Will you help Diego and Dora travel to the Lost Island to find a friend for him?

videos.title: Alicia and Whitetail to the Rescue
videos.overview: Uh, oh! There's a rockslide in the desert! Dieg's moving the deer away from the rockslide and Alicia needs to make sure that no deer get left behind. Alicia finds a baby deer stuck in some bushes near the rockslide.

videos.title: Manatee's Mermaid Rescue!
videos.overview: Diego and Manatee set off on a mission to rescue mermaids who are trapped behind a stone wall.

videos.title: Tuga Helps the Moon
videos.overview: The newly hatched baby sea turtles need moonlight to find their way back to the ocean, but when Luna breaks apart, Diego and Tuga the Leatherback Sea Turtle need your help to find the moon's four pieces so she can shine brightly again!

videos.title: Freddie the Fruit Bat Saves Halloween!
videos.overview: Freddie the Fruit Bat must help the llamas cross the broken bridge so they can deliver the treats to Diego's Halloween party on time.

videos.title: Egyptian Camel Adventure
videos.overview: Help Diego, his friend Medina, and Jamal the Camel on an Egyptian journey to the Great Pyramids to find the Golden Cloud that will bring rain to the thirsty camels of the desert.

videos.title: A New Flamingo Mami
videos.overview: Diego needs you on a mountain rescue to help Miami Flamingo make it back to Flamingo Lake in time to see her baby hatch... and to save the rising lake water too!

videos.title: The Great Polar Bear Rescue
videos.overview: Diego, Dora, Alicia, and Baby Jaguar go to the Arctic to save some baby polar bears from melting ice.

videos.title: Diego Reunites Hippo & Oxpecker
videos.overview: Hippopotamus is moving to a new home at Hippo Lake, but he needs help from Diego and you to rescue his "symbiotic" friend Oxpecker, who's stuck back at the old river!

videos.title: Diego's Orangutan Rescue
videos.overview: When playful Baby Orangutan gets taken away in a canoe by a rapid river in Borneo, Diego needs to team up with Big Sister Orangutan and you to save him!

videos.title: Where is Okapi's Brother?
videos.overview: Diego, Alicia and Baby Jaguar travel to the African rainforest to visit the okapis. During a game of hide-and-seek, Okapi's brother hids too well and gets lost! It's up to Diego to find him!

videos.title: Puffin Fish Adventure
videos.overview: Bundle up for adventure in Greenland as you and Diego help Puffy the Puffin lead the baby puffins to a fishy snack.

videos.title: Diego and Dora Help Baby Monarch Get to the Festival
videos.overview: Diego and Dora are heading to the annual Monarch Butterfly Festival when they discover a baby monarch on Snowy Mountain who's afraid to leave her cocoon. Can they help her in time to make it to the festivities?

videos.title: All Aboard the Giant Panda Express!
videos.overview: Hop aboard the Giant Panda Express to help Diego and Baby Jaguar find a family of pandas in China and bring them to their new home on Bamboo Mountain.

videos.title: Diego's Ringed Seal Rescue
videos.overview: It's an adventure in the Arctic when Diego needs to bring a baby ringed seal back to the Ringed Seal Rescue Home!

videos.title: Leaping Lemurs!
videos.overview: To Make a Sifaka Lemur smile really big, Diego and Baby Jaguar need to help her find family in Madagascar. Will You Help too?

videos.title: Diego Saves the Beavers
videos.overview: When a giant wave threatens some beavers and other animals in the Canadian Rockies, Diego and Billy the Beaver need to work together with you for a river rescue

videos.title: Ocean Animal Rescuer
videos.overview: Baby Humpback is in danger after an oil spill in the ocean

videos.title: Welcome Home, Lion Cub
videos.overview: Travel to Africa with Diego and Baby Jaguar to help Daddy Lion and his family make it back to their pride in time for Lion Cub's party.

videos.title: Diego's International Rescue League
videos.overview: Diego leads a team of expert animal rescuers, and together they return five eggs to their habitats and earn their World Rescuers' patches.

videos.title: Diego Rescues Prince Vicuna
videos.overview: Prince Vicuña goes missing, so Diego goes on a search that takes him on a mountain path and through a cactus forest.

videos.title: To Babysit a Bobo
videos.overview: Diego must help the Bobo brothers find their three little sisters.

videos.title: Pampas Cat & Friends Help the Rescue Center
videos.overview: A Pampas cat needs Diego's help to find her kittens.

videos.title: Cotton-Top Tamarin Cave Rescue
videos.overview: When the Bobos block the exit of a cave, Diego must find another way out.
